title: Chrome autofill and card data
whyItMatters: Stores names, addresses, phone numbers, email addresses and saved payment cards typed into web forms. It is a ready-made profile of the person behind the browser.
source: Chromium user data directory docs, profile files include Web Data: https://chromium.googlesource.com/chromium/src/+/main/docs/user_data_dir.md
notes: One Web Data file per profile. Card numbers are encrypted with the Windows account; addresses and autofill values are stored as readable text.
